bibl.title: Exit Bishop Tamer - the Sequel. A New Edition of the Epitaph of Papsine alias Doulista (DBMNT 78).
bibl.seg: Jacques van der Vliet, Exit Bishop Tamer - the Sequel. A New Edition of the Epitaph of Papsine alias Doulista (DBMNT 78).
bibl.note: Re-edition of a twelfth-century epitaph in Greek (Turin, Museo Egizio, No. d'Inv. Cat. 7142; I. Lefebvre 636 = S.B. V, 8728), formerly attributed to a bishop of Faras in Nubia [see also: Jacques van der Vliet, Exit Tamer, Bishop of Faras (SB V 8728), JJurP 37 (2007) pp. 185-191]. In addition to presenting a new text, based on autopsy, the article discusses the ownership of the monument and advocates a new understanding of the linguistic and textual form of the epitaph.
